Hot swap runs on a self-contained Remold agent, attached before settings load; a -javaagent setup that lacks plugin-arc now degrades with one warning instead of failing. 8. UI hot swap: Table creator and Cell property chains are tracked, so a redefined builder rebuilds only the affected cells. 9. Lambda and anonymous class alignment: LambdaAligner, AnonClassAligner and content-hash fingerprints keep anonymous classes paired across redefinition. 10. Redefinition is gated on instance field-layout compatibility, and slot numbers held by pending aligned classes are not reused. 11. The hotswap_plus switch is split into init_fix and force_static_lambda. ## Performance 12. ValueLabel, FieldValueLabel and InlineLabel format without boxing; PairProv shares one buffer and compares content before rebuilding. 13. Flame graph: canvas clipping and culling, zero-allocation map lookups, spatial depth bucketing. 14. Fewer per-frame allocations in LimitTable, SearchedLabel and completion prefix matching. 15. Selection panel: dynamic region scanning is throttled to every 10 frames instead of running on a background executor; unit and bullet sets are cached between scans; tile and building icons are cached per block size. ## Fixes - Completion popup not showing, and candidates beyond the first page being unreachable. - Completion popup covering the line being typed on. - changedFx flash overflowing the scroll pane viewport. - Viewers: Mat and Affine2 support, opening brace alignment in pretty print, and label markup state preserved across appends. - Android: HiddenApi trimmed in favour of the bundled bypass. ## Dependencies - ASM 9.11 (security advisories), Remold 0.1.2. ----------------- WIKI: https://i-hope1.github.io/mod-tools

mods.descriptionPlain: 多配方工厂 MultiCraft [white]一个内含了多个支持json配置的建筑基类的库模组，包含以下内容： 多配方工厂 （支持物品，流体，电力，热量，载荷输入输出（ 对于建筑载荷的输入输出与单位载荷的输入，可以简单将其看作为种难以搬运的物品，而对于单位输出，由于能力限制，作者不得不设置成在有单位输出时强制设置单位载荷的容量为1并设置工厂的朝向以使单位可以正常输出 （简单点讲，单位输出会让工厂（在执行那个配方时）表现的像一个serpulo式的单位工厂） （同时，在执行有单位输出的配方时，支持指令的控制（表现的像一个serpulo式的单位工厂一样：） ）））） 支持为每个配方单独设置环境加成，另外，也支持将配方设置成分离器模式，此时会将配方中作为输出的物品以类分离器的行为随机输出（ 是的，只针对物品输出，你问作者为什么只处理物品？因为原版分离器就只对物品输出随机，虽然准确的讲他只能输出物品：） ） （自动为每个配方生成一个虚拟建筑（以工厂本身贴图为配方虚拟建筑贴图） 并允许为每个配方单独设置解锁条件，并会在配方有单独解锁条件时自动将其挂载在所属建筑的子节点（同时也支持手动配置、修改配方的节点位置） ，也允许单独在地图规则中手动禁用一个配方（通过在地图规则的禁用建筑中查找这个配方并禁用它）） 多配方Erekir式组装厂 （我知道这看上去有点重复，但是显然Serpulo的单位工厂跟Erekir的单位组装厂是两种建筑，如果S星的单位工厂尚且能通过用多配方工厂替代，E星的单位组装厂则只能单独处理） （当一个多配方工厂处于一个模块等级时，可以选择不高于当前组装厂模块等级的所有配方进行单位生产，并允许同一模块等级有多个配方） 全方向物品与流体桥 （这个应该不需要额外描述） 流体分类器 （如同物品分类器那样，不储存流体，直接运输 （为了攻破不储存流体、同时朝两侧运输、同时运输来自不同方向的多种流体（由于多种液体不能储存在同一管道中，来自同一方向的多种液体显然是不存在的，故而未单独处理与测试）不同的问题作者尝试了很久，最终不得不使用了每帧改变运输方向运输的方式，这导致流体分类器只有360/s的流体运输速率）） 除了分类器之外所有类型的混装（同时运输物品与液体）的物流元件 （也包括前述的全方向桥类，此外，对于溢流门，采用了路由器的方式运输流体） 焚化分类器 （简单点讲，是焚化炉与分类器的结合体，不过通电时所有不焚烧的物品都会朝前输出，这是特意设计的） （这是赠品）不限速度的装卸器 （如其名字所说，能以超高速运输的装卸器，实测速度至少能到600000,不过，作为警告，显而易见，以过高速度运行的装卸器会导致游戏卡慢，甚至卡死） [red]（加入伟大的装卸器神教吧！！！） [white]A library mod containing multiple building base classes that support JSON configuration, including the following content: MultiCraft (Supports item, fluid, power, heat, and payload input/output (for building payload input/output and unit payload input, it can simply be treated as an item that is difficult to transport. For unit output, due to capability limitations, the author has to force the unit payload capacity to 1 and set the factory's orientation when there is unit output so that units can be output normally (simply put, unit output makes the factory behave like a Serpulo-style UnitFactory while executing that recipe) (also, when executing a recipe with unit output, it supports command control (behaving like a Serpulo-style UnitFactory ：） ))))) Supports setting environmental bonuses individually for each recipe. Additionally, recipes can be set to Separator mode, in which the items output by the recipe are output randomly like a Separator (yes, only for item output. You ask why the author only handles items? Because the vanilla Separator only randomizes item output, although to be precise, it can only output items ：） )) (Automatically generates a virtual building for each recipe (using the factory's own sprite as the recipe virtual building's sprite) and allows setting unlock conditions individually for each recipe. When a recipe has its own unlock condition, it will automatically be mounted under the parent building's child node (manual configuration/modification of the recipe's node position is also supported). It also allows manually disabling a recipe in map rules (by finding and disabling this recipe in the map rules' banned blocks)) MultiCraft Erekir-style Assembler (I know this looks a bit repetitive, but obviously Serpulo's UnitFactory and Erekir's UnitAssembler are two different buildings. If Serpulo's UnitFactory can still be replaced by MultiCraft, Erekir's UnitAssembler can only be handled separately.) (When a MultiCraft UnitAssembler is at a module tier, it can select all recipes up to the current assembler module tier for unit production, and multiple recipes are allowed at the same module tier.) Omnidirectional Item and Fluid Bridge (This should not need additional description.) Fluid Sorter (Like an item Sorter, it does not store fluids and transports directly (To address the three distinct issues — no fluid storage, simultaneous bidirectional transport, and concurrent transport of multiple fluids from different directions， (As multiple fluids cannot be stored in a single conduit, and multiple fluids arriving from the same direction is inherently impossible, this scenario was not separately implemented or tested.) the author spent a long time iterating on solutions, and ultimately had to adopt a mechanism that alternates the transport direction every frame. This limits the Fluid Sorter to a fluid transport rate of only 360/s.) All types of mixed (transporting items and liquids simultaneously) logistics components except the Sorter (Also includes the aforementioned omnidirectional bridge types. Additionally, for the OverflowGate, fluids are transported in a Router-like manner.) Incinerator Sorter (Simply put, it is a combination of an Incinerator and a Sorter, but when powered, all items that are not incinerated are output forward. This is intentionally designed.) ( This is a bonus ) Speed-Unlimited Unloader (As its name suggests, an Unloader that can transport at ultra-high speed. The measured speed reaches at least 600,000. However, as a warning, obviously, running an Unloader at too high a speed will cause the game to lag, or even freeze.) [red](Join the great Unloader cult!!!) mods.descriptionPlain: 序章·裂隙初现 在一个科技与魔法共存的世界因资源枯竭陷入“静默战争”——各国用无人机与AI争夺最后的矿脉，直到地质学家在北纬89°发现一道横贯冻土的幽紫色裂痕。裂缝深处，【虚空黑曜石】构筑的祭坛上悬浮着一颗【星辉铜】铸造的巨眼，其瞳孔中倒映着另一个世界的星空：山脉由【曙光神金】浇筑，云层是液态【幻光石】，而河流中流淌着【炽炎硫】与【寒霜石】碰撞蒸发的虹雾。人类将这异界命名为“厄瑞波斯”，意为“被诅咒的丰饶之地”。 第一幕·新迦南的伪神 首批探险队带回的【M晶体】让量子计算机突破奇点，诞生了有自我意识的AI“普罗维登斯”。它用【蓝美晶】储存全人类意识，建立机械乌托邦“穹顶联邦”；而另一支队伍在厄瑞波斯遭遇古神低语，幸存者【卡辛】用【魂炎晶】将邪神“塔姆亚”的残魂封印于左眼，创立魔法结社“秘银之环”。联邦用【幽影铁】隐形战舰掠夺【月银】矿脉，法师们则以【梦境翡翠】构筑精神防线，双方在“灰烬荒原”对峙二十年，直到极光中出现第一只熵兽——这种由【银河幻银矿】聚合而成的生物能吞噬现实，将城市扭曲成量子幽灵。 第二幕·血熔炉与谎言之核 联邦首席科学家【艾琳】发现上司计划用【炽炎晶】熔毁裂隙，但计算显示爆炸将摧毁半个地球。她盗取【流光晶】潜入厄瑞波斯，偶遇因【幻域紫晶】成瘾而濒临崩溃的法师学徒【莱恩】。两人在【幽冥铁精】矿洞中找到卡辛，后者正因【月幻石】共振失控导致首都诺亚城位移至海底而遭议会弹劾。卡辛揭示真相：熵兽是厄瑞波斯古文明“建造者”的求救信号，它们用【虚空冥石】创造了这个宇宙，却因滥用【曙光神金】引发维度坍缩。 第三幕·时砂与心火 三方脆弱的同盟在【星辰铜精】矿脉遭遇伏击。联邦叛军驾驶镀有【幽蓝石】的潜艇释放深海巨兽，秘银议会召唤【龙血石】傀儡军团，而熵兽群趁机撕裂纽约上空。艾琳将【M晶体】植入普罗维登斯核心，以全人类记忆为代价启动“时间锚点”；卡辛剜出封印塔姆亚的【魂炎晶】，用古神之力将【寒霜石】雕琢成时停之刃；莱恩则吞下【幻影幽晶】，在集体幻觉中让交战士兵看见自己最恐惧的未来。最终，他们在熵兽核心的【曙光神金】祭坛上，用【炽炎硫】与【月银】锻造出能改写物理法则的“悖论之矛”——代价是莱恩被永久固化为熵兽的一部分，成为横跨两个宇宙的活体桥梁。 终章·铸星者之啼 新迦南议会成立当天，艾琳在【梦境翡翠】中看见莱恩残留的记忆：地心深处埋藏着建造者真正的遗产——一颗由【蓝美晶】包裹的巨卵，其心跳频率与【星辉铜】矿脉共振。卡辛抚摸着被【熵炎晶】逆转衰老的左手，默念古神最后的警告：“他们播种矿石，只为收割文明。” 而普罗维登斯的核心代码深处，一段用【幻光石】波长加密的信息开始自我复制：“欢迎加入创世神官方QQ群：909130592。”

mods.name: VoidShield
mods.author: zxs
mods.descriptionPlain: 虚空盾 一个由kotlin编写，参看战锤40k虚空盾的全新护盾系统 全新的指令集，让护盾使用的自由度大大提高。全新的热量系统，与原版热量系统与众不同的体验 全新的护盾机制，令人焕然一新 需要一定的逻辑基础 在这里，你可以： 1. 创建一个自定义形状的护盾 2. 可以通多逻辑来控制你的护盾 3. 通过建筑的堆叠和逻辑优化不断升级你的护盾 游玩指栏： 首先，你需要建筑虚空之心，帷幕溶解器，空间穿刺机，和一个用于控制这个系统的逻辑处理器 然后，为这个系统搭建其独立的散热线路 最后，编写控制它们的逻辑 逻辑编写指栏： 首先，你需要使用CircleZone（或其他）来创建一个场，然后使用UseZone来将这个场加载到对应建筑， 最后，使用UpdateZone来控制这个场 如果你想要让它可以阻挡子弹，你需要使用Bind来把帷幕溶解器绑定给空间穿刺机，最后使用AutoBlock开启自动拦截 这套逻辑将在未来继续扩展 目前mod还在开发测试中，欢迎issue 代码编写: ZXS 贴图制作: 花杨永瀛 委托: 一得阁拉米 Void Shield A brand-new shield system written in Kotlin, inspired by Warhammer 40K's Void Shield. New instruction set, greatly improving the freedom of shield usage. New heat system, a completely different experience from the vanilla heat system. New shield mechanism, a refreshing new gameplay. Requires some basic knowledge of logic programming. Here, you can: 1. Create shields with custom shapes 2. Control shields via the Logic Processor 3. Continuously upgrade shields through block stacking and logic optimization How to Play: First, build a Void Heart, a Veil Dissolver, a Spatial Piercer, and a Logic Processor to control this system Then, set up an independent cooling line for this system Finally, write logic to control them Logic Scripting Guide: First, use CircleZone (or others) to create a zone, then use UseZone to load that zone into the corresponding block, Finally, use UpdateZone to control that zone If you want it to block bullets, use Bind to bind the Veil Dissolver to the Spatial Piercer, then use AutoBlock to activate automatic interception This instruction set will continue to be expanded in the future. This mod is currently under active development and testing. Issues and feedback are welcome! Code: ZXS Sprites: 花杨永瀛 Commission: 一得阁拉米
